ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely low; the ventral surface is dominated by low-intensity (black) pixels with high-intensity (white) pixels limited to localized anomalies and minor specular highlights near the edges.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: A near-uniform dark mass occupying >98% of the surface area; a distinct high-contrast white cluster is located at the extreme left distal tip; two small, discrete circular white spots are visible in the upper-left lobe region.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped indentation; the central notch vertex is sharp and clearly defined, extending approximately 12-15% into the vertical depth of the fluke.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serrated profile along the entire trailing boundary; numerous irregular peaks and troughs are visible, with the highest amplitude serrations located on the lateral thirds of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical upward and outward convex curvature originating from the median notch and extending to the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: A dense, high-contrast white cluster of irregular pixel groupings is localized at the far left tip; two distinct circular white points are present on the upper interior of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy biological encrustation or physical trauma-induced irregularity at the left fluke tip; two small circular hypopigmented spots on the left lobe surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Significant morphological asymmetry between the fluke tips; the left tip exhibits a jagged, bulbous silhouette compared to the more tapered and smooth profile of the right tip.
